Det norske Utenriksdepartementet (UD) står bak appen Reiseklar, som samler reiseinformasjon om 200 land, UDs reiseråd og reiseregistrering på ett sted. Velger du å registrere reisen din eller aktiverer lokasjonstjenester i appen vil du kunne få meldinger fra norske myndigheter dersom det oppstår en krise i landet du befinner deg i. Appen Reiseklar gir deg nyttige tips om andre land og bidrar til å gjøre deg reiseklar før utenlandsturen. Du finner annen nyttig informasjon på reiseklar.ud247.no

VKT Reise allows you to easily plan your public transport journey in Vestfold.   You can plan your journey by searching for departures from A to B. You can see your entire journey on a route map, including walking time and changes between means of transport. You can also see departure times in real time (local buses). Real time is displayed in yellow.  Disruption information is also available.

You can use VKT Mobilbillett - a smartphone ticket app - to buy single tickets or day pass tickets in the categories child, adult and senior for our bus departures in Vestfold. The smartphone ticket is ideal for those who ride a bus occasionally and who don’t have a transit pass.
 
When you set up the app you register a Visa or MasterCard. Ticket costs are then automatically charged to your account.
 
How to buy a ticket:
In the current version you can buy tickets for predefined routes, or select departure and arrival points.
 
Advantages of VKT’s Mobilbillett:
- You can travel without carrying cash
- You always have your ticket available on your smartphone
- You can download your smartphone ticket on your wireless network.
- You can pay the fare for several people, for example friends or family.
 
Validity:
The ticket is valid for one and a half hours from the time it’s downloaded. You must also have the ticket available for inspection.
